note: Countries likely to vote within ~14 months that are not yet in data/countries. The weekly update researches these first.

countries.name: Lesotho
countries.why: National Assembly election due by about October 2027; no date set as of Oct 2026

countries.name: Dominica
countries.why: General election due by early 2028, may be called in 2027

countries.name: Republic of the Congo
countries.why: Legislative election due by July 2027; no date set as of Oct 2026

countries.name: Libya
countries.why: June 2026 roadmap by rival institutions calls for simultaneous presidential and parliamentary elections by 17 Feb 2027; no electoral commission date yet

countries.name: Madagascar
countries.why: Transition plan: referendum May to July 2027, presidential election before end of 2027 (allAfrica, Oct 2026); dates may be revised

countries.name: Slovenia
countries.why: Presidential election due autumn 2027 (term ends Dec 2027); incumbent Pirc Musar undeclared

countries.name: Tajikistan
countries.why: Presidential election due by about October 2027 (seven-year term from Oct 2020)

countries.name: Equatorial Guinea
countries.why: Parliamentary election due about November 2027 (last held Nov 2022)

countries.name: Tunisia
countries.why: ISIE spokesman said on 23 Oct 2026 that the legislative election should be in November or December 2027 (indicative, no date set; last held Dec 2022 to Jan 2023)

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.why: General election due by Feb 2028 (parliament dissolves automatically Dec 2027); may be called earlier in 2027

countries.name: Senegal
countries.why: One report: a minister said the National Assembly is dissolved on 2 Dec 2026, with early legislative elections in 2027; unconfirmed

countries.name: Nicaragua
countries.why: General election moved from Nov 2026 by constitutional change; sources conflict on Nov 2027 or 2028; second vote on a further reform due from 18 Jan 2027

countries.name: Oman
countries.why: Shura Council election expected about Oct 2027 (last held 29 Oct 2023)

countries.name: Tuvalu
countries.why: General election expected about Jan 2028 (IPU expected date 31 Jan 2028); no parties. Not in the 50m map file (no country shape), so it may not colour on the map

countries.name: Belgium
countries.why: Prime Minister De Wever offered his resignation on 2 Nov 2026 over the budget; the King holds it in abeyance and decides on 6 Nov. If the Chamber is dissolved, a vote follows within 40 days

countries.name: India
countries.why: Indirect presidential election due about July 2027; no date set
